descriptions.winger: Wingers are a synonym for danger from the flanks. Their incursions are a nightmare for DLs and DRs because of their crosses, speed and dribbling skills.
descriptions.inside_forward: The Inside Forward will cut into the open space and create a scoring opportunity for the STs, or engage the goalkeeper directly and finish himself.
descriptions.sweeper_keeper: The Sweeper Keeper feels comfortable playing out of his area, rushing out to intercept opponents' long balls. A proper 11th outfield player whenever needed.
descriptions.false_winger: Deployed on the wings, False Wingers drift to central areas of the pitch, creating a numerical advantage in the midfield that disrupts and overwhelms rival defences.
descriptions.ball_playing_dc: Ball-playing DCs are a balanced mix of defensive solvency and technique. They stop attacks and fluidly pass the ball to the midfield, or hold it to calm the waters.
descriptions.full_back: Full-backs' focus is primarily defence. It's their job to stop hazards coming from the sides, even if they will occasionally support fast-paced offensives from their flanks.
descriptions.enganche: The Enganche is a quick-minded skilled driver that connects midfield and attack, moving the ball forward fast. He displays great technical and assisting skills.
descriptions.anchor_man: The Anchor Man stands in front of the defensive line. He anticipates any opposing action in that area, and distributes the ball to players in more forward positions.
descriptions.box_to_box: Present in a large area of the field, the Box-to-box MC appears wherever needed, supporting other midfielders. He can take part in both attacking and defending plays.
descriptions.wing_back: Wing-backs are defenders that thrive on attack. They run up their flanks, overlapping side midfielders, and giving crosses or dragging opposing defenders' attention.
descriptions.ball_winner: A mainly defensive midfielder, the Ball Winner is very proficient at steals and tackles. He holds the line, gets the ball and gives it to the playmaker.
descriptions.ball_playing_gk: A Ball-playing GK can play with his feet, contributing to the team's passing game. He can help build up the offensive play or trigger a counter attack with a well-aimed pass.
descriptions.box_commander: The Box Commander imposes his rules in the box. His presence, both physically and mentally, intimidates the most seasoned STs. He becomes a giant on the goal line.
descriptions.target_man: The Target Man is a magnet for aerial passes in the attacking line. He'll either finish or hold up the ball against the DCs and wait for teammates to join the offensive.
descriptions.poacher: Scoring goals is the Poacher's only focus. Always waiting on the edges of the opponents' defensive line, any ball he finds in the penalty area can become a hazard.
descriptions.stopper: Stoppers are blunt but precise when it comes to neutralising the attackers' attempts to score. They are experts in marking and tackling. A life insurance in the box.
descriptions.false_nine: A skilled ball driver, the False Nine receives the ball deep and brings danger to the surroundings of the box, forcing DCs to break their position.
descriptions.mezzala: A Mezzala brings dynamism to the midfield and feeds their teammates with his passing skills and space creation. Teammates with high mobility will get the most from him.
descriptions.regista: The Regista is a director. With only few yet very precise and effective actions he
descriptions.no_nonsense_dc: A No-nonsense DC has one job: to clear the ball out at the slightest sign of danger. He acts fast and decisively, leaving no room for flourishes or mistakes.
